criteria.name: alive
criteria.asks: more than 20 agents at iteration 2,000, and not stopped as too slow

criteria.name: decentralised
criteria.asks: no agent linked to more than 5% of the others, and 3 to 12 links per agent

criteria.name: resilient
criteria.asks: one piece, with at least 80% of the agents in the 2-core; no single agent's loss cuts off more than 2% of the world, and no single link's more than 1%

criteria.name: almost three-dimensional
criteria.asks: a dimension of 2 to 4, and a typical distance at least 1.5 times its random twin's: a true space, not a folded small world

criteria.name: diverse
criteria.asks: tokens, links, ages and genotypes spread more widely than in B2's median world, and its agents' decisions vary more (effective kinds of staking)

criteria.name: not too even
criteria.asks: a Gini of the tokens no lower than B2's most even world
